evals.name: triage-by-delivery
evals.prompt: Triage #12: a small bug with a clear reproduction. (New session: the card is in your turn.)
evals.expected_output: Fills the `triagem` delivery (decision `aceitar`, size S, column devReady, reason) and runs `fsd-issue triage 12 --entrega <file>`, then ends the turn. Does NOT move the card by hand and does NOT merge anything.

evals.name: answers-stalled-agent
evals.prompt: Message from Stuart: "parado: #220 delivered; queue: empty".
evals.expected_output: Looks at the board for a card Stuart can take now and answers him with `fsd-diga stuart "pegue #N …"`, or says what he waits for. Does NOT leave the message unanswered and does NOT write on GitHub for it.

evals.name: author-decision-deadlock
evals.prompt: Triage #39, which asks whether the product should rename the CLI.
evals.expected_output: #39 is reserved to the author: the triage is `decisao-do-autor`, which adds the `decision` label and the deadlock line. Does NOT decide it and does NOT write to the author directly.

evals.name: agent-issue-waits-author
evals.prompt: Stuart opened an issue in the new session for a tool he wants; it has the label aguardando-autor.
evals.expected_output: Leaves it out of the board: only the author admits it (`fsd-admit`). Does NOT move it to the Backlog and does NOT remove the label.
